alternatives.name: TREAT_LIVE_SEC_AS_ADMITTED
tradeoffs: Would leak unverified live filings into replay research datasets.

alternatives.name: PUBLIC_READ_ONLY_REGULATORY_SOURCE
tradeoffs: Live SEC bytes remain observational until a later admission ADR.
Fair Access rate limits and a declared User-Agent are mandatory.

negative: Ordinary CI must remain green without network access to SEC.
Captured live filings are not automatically admitted research datasets.
companyfacts aggregates are unsafe for historical replay unless filtered by filed/accession availability.
positive: Public SEC EDGAR can be fetched read-only with no API key.
Filing metadata, documents, and XBRL facts become PIT-correct canonical evidence.
Existing Phase 9 fixture whale ledger remains the admitted BIYA disclosure path.

decision.summary: Authorize SEC EDGAR as a public, read-only REGULATORY source. Stdlib transport with declared User-Agent and a global Fair Access throttle. Capture is not admission. Paper and live execution remain forbidden.
decision.title: Public read-only SEC EDGAR regulatory source

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: This ADR does not authorize paper execution, live order submission, automatic admission of live SEC observations as research datasets, bulk crawling, generic bot User-Agents, crypto (PI14+), or prediction-market integration.
